onboardingWelcomeDesc.message: Your tabs, organized. Save, search, and restore your browser tabs with one click.

onboardingStep1Desc.message: Press Alt+Shift+A or click the extension icon to save all open tabs at once.

onboardingStep2Desc.message: Group tabs into workspaces. Use the search bar to find any tab instantly.

onboardingStep3Desc.message: Click Restore to reopen a tab. Restore All to reopen everything at once.

onboardingCompleteDesc.message: Your tabs will never be lost again. Save your first tabs now!
